description: Edit a channel's name, topic, slowmode, NSFW flag, or category, a voice channel's bitrate, user limit, region, and video quality, how long its threads stay open, and a forum's default reaction, sort, layout, post slowmode, and whether posts need a tag. Only passed fields change. Pass category "none" to move a channel out of its category. Supports dry_run.

bitrate_kbps.description: Voice and stage audio quality in kbps. Up to 96 without boosts, 128, 256, and 384 at boost levels 1 to 3.

category.description: Category name or ID, or "none" to remove.

default_reaction.description: Forum: the emoji offered on every post, as a character or a custom emoji name; none to remove.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

post_slowmode_seconds.description: Forum: the slowmode each new post starts with.

region.description: Voice region id such as us-east or rotterdam, or automatic.

require_tag.description: Forum: posts must carry at least one tag.

thread_archive_minutes.description: How long new threads stay open without activity: 60, 1440 (a day), 4320, or 10080 (a week).

user_limit.description: Most people at once, 0 for no limit. Up to 99 in voice, 10000 in stage.

video_quality.description: Camera quality in voice channels: auto, or full (720p).

name: update_channel
title: Update channel
